description: Recreate this site's Stripe webhook with the gateway's own routine: a new endpoint is created first, then older endpoints for this site's URL are deleted, and the new signing secret is stored on the site (never returned). Use when stripe_list_webhooks shows no enabled configured endpoint. Needs confirm:true; audit-logged.

confirm.description: Must be true: this changes the live Stripe account

name: stripe_recreate_webhook
